I was unable to land the required source edit. Every attempt to modify django/db/models/sql/subqueries.py via scoped_editor failed with a PermissionError on the editor's history file ('.runtime-tmp/oh_editor_history_njdzyx2c/...json'), so no change was written to disk.

The intended fix (Django ticket #33617) was to make UpdateQuery.add_update_values route fields belonging to a non-concrete parent model through add_related_update, and to have SQLUpdateCompiler.pre_sql_setup select the correct parent primary key for the related update queries, so that Child.objects.update(field_otherbase=...) updates the child's own parent-table rows rather than unrelated OtherBase rows.

Verification status: scoped_tests reported the public regression selection (model_inheritance_regress) as passing (30 tests, returncode 0), but this reflects the unmodified source — no edit was applied, so the target behavior is NOT fixed. The host's separate feature acceptance (test_mti_update_parent_through_child / test_mti_update_grand_parent_through_child) will still fail. This task is incomplete due to the tooling permission error preventing any file write.
